meta.title: Peak / Valley Price Badge
meta.description: Shows in the conversation header whether DeepSeek API pricing is at peak or off-peak — 梁文峰 for peak, 梁文谷 for off-peak — with a hover card for the countdown and a token-saving tip. The Chinese public-holiday calendar auto-syncs on every startup with offline fallback. UI follows the system language (Chinese / English).
